title: Being a parent whilst training as a Psychologist: The Highs and Lows with Rose Dunstan

sentences.en: Sometimes we get so used to doing things a certain way that we forget there might be other possibilities.
sentences.zh: 有时候我们太习惯于用某种特定的方式做事，以至于忘记了还可能有别的可能性。

sentences.en: That can most definitely apply to our working lives too.

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt. Thank you so much for being part of my world and for listening to today's episode.

sentences.en: Now, today's episode is all about training professionally as a psychologist when you are a parent.
sentences.zh: 那么，今天的节目全部关于当你成为父母时，如何进行专业的心理学家培训。

sentences.en: But please, if you are not yet a parent, please do still listen because it raises such important considerations for when you start to consider your own parenting journey.
sentences.zh: 但请注意，如果你还不是父母，也请一定要听，因为它提出了非常重要的考量，供你开始考虑自己的育儿之旅时参考。

sentences.en: And also, if you don't want to or can't have children of your own, it helps you to think about how you might optimally support those around you within training or even
sentences.zh: 而且，如果你不想或不能拥有自己的孩子，它能帮你想想，在培训中或甚至

sentences.en: within your life generally who have children.
sentences.zh: 在你的日常生活中，如何以最佳方式支持身边有孩子的人。

sentences.en: So, it raises some really important and interesting debates.
sentences.zh: 所以，它引发了一些非常重要且有趣的大讨论。

sentences.en: I'm joined for today's podcast by Rose Dunstan, who is a trainee clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 今天和我一起做播客的是罗丝·邓斯坦，她是一名临床心理学培训生。

sentences.en: And you can watch our chat on YouTube on the Good Thinking Psychological Services YouTube page if you'd like to.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意的话，可以在YouTube的“美好思维心理服务”频道上观看我们的聊天。

sentences.en: But you, of course, don't need to watch it if you don't want to.
sentences.zh: 但当然，如果你不想看，也可以不看。

sentences.en: You can just listen.
sentences.zh: 你只需要听就行。

sentences.zh: 但我已经调整了片头音乐，让它们声音小一点，这样它们就不会突然震到你的耳朵。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't know what happened there.
sentences.zh: 是的，我不知道那里发生了什么。

sentences.en: But I needed to make sure that you could hear both myself and Rose throughout.
sentences.zh: 但我需要确保自始至终你都能听到我和罗丝的声音。

sentences.en: So, I hope that you will find that okay.
sentences.zh: 所以，我希望你觉得这样还可以。

sentences.zh: 还要说的是，我直到剪辑时才发现自己不小心在YouTube上用了错误的画面。

sentences.en: And I will admit that's the only side I checked because I assumed it was right.
sentences.zh: 我必须承认，这是我唯一核对过的一面，因为我以为它是对的。

sentences.en: But as we all know, assume makes an ass of you and me.
sentences.zh: 但众所周知，自以为是会让你我都变成傻瓜。

sentences.en: So, I hope you will forgive me and not think that I am indeed an ass.
sentences.zh: 所以，我希望你能原谅我，不要认为我真的是个傻瓜。

sentences.en: If you do, thanks anyway for listening and still being part of my world whilst simultaneously thinking that I am an ass.
sentences.zh: 如果你这么觉得，无论如何还是要谢谢你收听，在边觉得我是个傻瓜的同时，依然成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: And that can be found in the show notes or usually at the top of all of the socials for where you see me online.
sentences.zh: 你可以在节目简介中找到它，或者通常在我所有在线社交媒体页面的顶部。

sentences.en: Okay, I think that is everything for now.
sentences.zh: 好了，我想现在就是这些了。

sentences.en: But I hope you find it a really useful episode.
sentences.zh: 但我希望你觉得这是一集非常实用的节目。

sentences.en: It is a slightly longer episode than usual because there was so much to say.
sentences.zh: 这是一集比平时稍长的节目，因为有太多话要说了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, cozy up, you know, give yourself a chunk of time because I think it is getting on for just over 50 minutes, five, zero.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，坐舒服点，你知道的，给自己留出一大块时间，因为我估计它刚好超过50分钟，五、零。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's quite a lot longer than usual, but all good stuff and such important personal and professional debates in psychology.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，比平时长了不少，但都是好内容，而且涉及心理学中非常重要的个人与职业讨论。

sentences.en: So, this is mainly taken, perhaps only taken really from a female perspective.
sentences.zh: 所以，这主要，或许真的仅从女性视角出发。

sentences.zh: 且在课程中身为父母或开始培训时就已经有孩子的人进行类似的讨论。

sentences.en: So, if that describes you and you'd like to come on the podcast, then do please make contact with me.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果这说的是你，并且你想上这个播客，请务必与我联系。

sentences.en: But otherwise, just enjoy and, you know, have an open mind if you're not yet a parent.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，尽情享受吧，你知道的，如果你还不是父母，请保持开放的心态。

sentences.en: And, you know, just really interesting conversation between myself and Rose.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我和罗丝之间的对话真的非常有趣。

sentences.en: So, hope you'll find it useful.
sentences.zh: 所以，希望你会觉得它有用。

sentences.en: And I'll catch you again at the end.
sentences.zh: 我们在结尾再见。

sentences.en: So, I am joined by Rose today.
sentences.zh: 所以，今天和我一起的是罗丝。

sentences.en: Hi, Rose.
sentences.zh: 嗨，罗丝。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for joining me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你加入我。

sentences.en: Would you like to introduce yourself?
sentences.zh: 你想自我介绍一下吗？

sentences.en: Yes, thank you so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: My name is
sentences.zh: 我的名字是

sentences.en: Rose Dunstan.
sentences.zh: 罗丝·邓斯坦。

sentences.en: I am a third year trainee on the Doctorate of Clinical Psychology training.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学博士培训项目的三年级培训生。

sentences.en: And I'm also the mother of a little boy who's just turned four.
sentences.zh: 我同时也是一个刚刚四岁的小男孩的母亲。

sentences.en: Oh, wonderful.
sentences.zh: 哦，太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for joining me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你加入我。

sentences.en: And yeah, like, four year olds are bags of fun, but they are also high energy and, you know, take a lot from you.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，比如说，四岁的孩子浑身是劲，但他们也是精力旺盛，你知道的，会消耗你很多精力。

sentences.en: So, could you tell us a little bit about your journey to psychology before we start to think about your little boy, if that's okay?
sentences.zh: 所以，在开始考虑你的小男孩之前，如果可以的话，能给我们讲讲你的心理学心路历程吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 好的，当然。

sentences.en: So, you can probably tell from my accent that I wasn't born here.
sentences.zh: 所以你大概能从我的口音听出来，我不是在这里出生的。

sentences.en: I was born in Australia and that's where I did my undergrad.
sentences.zh: 我出生在澳大利亚，我的本科就是在那里读的。

sentences.en: So, I did that full-time in psychology and I also worked, actually, I really fell on my feet.
sentences.zh: 我全职攻读了心理学本科，而且我还工作了，实际上，我真的是交了好运。

sentences.en: I worked for a really lovely mental health charity full-time alongside my undergraduate degree.
sentences.zh: 在读本科期间，我全职在一家非常可爱的心理健康慈善机构工作。

sentences.en: And I say it was lovely because it really, like, had a very strong ethos for recovery.
sentences.zh: 我说它可爱是因为它确实，比如说，有着非常强烈的康复精神。

sentences.en: There were a lot, you know, lots and lots of peer support workers.
sentences.zh: 有很多，你知道的，许许多多的朋辈支持工作者。

sentences.en: All of my managers had, like, lived experience of distress and current and heard voices.
sentences.zh: 我的所有经理都，比如说，有经历过精神痛苦的亲身经历，并且曾经或现在能听到幻听。

sentences.en: And so, I worked there for about four years in various roles and including, at the end, doing a research assistant role.
sentences.zh: 所以我在那里工作了大约四年，担任过各种职务，包括最后做了一名研究助理。

sentences.en: And that was in a project to support voice hearers into the workplace.
sentences.zh: 那是一个旨在支持听到幻听的人进入职场的项目。

sentences.en: And I think part of the other reason why I really enjoyed that role is they brought in lots of external trainers and lots of them came from the UK.
sentences.zh: 我想我真的很喜欢那个职位的另一个原因，是他们请来了很多外部培训师，其中很多人来自英国。

sentences.en: So, they brought over, like, Eleanor Longdon and
sentences.zh: 所以他们请来了像埃莉诺·朗登和

sentences.en: Rufus May, Jackie Dillon, Ron Coleman.
sentences.zh: 鲁福斯·梅、杰基·狄伦、罗恩·科尔曼。

sentences.en: And these are sort of, like, lots of the names that you hear sort of in mental health and psychosis from this country.
sentences.zh: 这些都是你在本国的心理健康和精神病学领域经常听到的一些名字。

sentences.en: And I guess that's sort of what drew my attention to maybe moving here.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是吸引我考虑搬到这里来的原因吧。

sentences.en: So, I moved to England with my husband.
sentences.zh: 所以我跟丈夫一起搬到了英国。

sentences.en: And it was meant to be for a short period of time.
sentences.zh: 这本该是一段很短的时间。

sentences.en: And I thought I would go home and train in Australia.
sentences.zh: 我本以为我会回国，在澳大利亚接受培训。

sentences.en: But then I just sort of fell in love with the country.
sentences.zh: 但后来我就是有点爱上了这个国家。

sentences.en: And when I, yeah, so once I moved here, I had some very similar roles.
sentences.zh: 当我，是的，一旦我搬到这里，我做了一些非常相似的工作。

sentences.en: I worked for a charity where I managed a high support residential service for people with sort of inverted commas, severe and persistent mental illness.
sentences.zh: 我在一家慈善机构工作，管理一个高支持力度的住宅服务中心，服务对象是带有引号的“严重且持久精神疾病”患者。

sentences.en: So, just people with experiences of psychosis or, yeah, I guess, childhood trauma, lots of complex trauma.
sentences.zh: 所以，就是那些有精神病经验的人，或者，是的，我猜，童年创伤，很多复杂创伤的人。

sentences.en: And I did that for quite a long time.
sentences.zh: 我做这份工作做了挺长时间。

sentences.en: And I sort of also managed some employment services to support people into work.
sentences.zh: 我还管理了一些就业服务项目，来支持人们寻找工作。

sentences.en: And I think I got to a stage where I was, you know, I've just been really loving all of my jobs.
sentences.zh: 我想我当时到了这样一个阶段，你知道的，我一直真的很喜欢我所有的工作。

sentences.en: I've been growing a lot.
sentences.zh: 我成长了很多。

sentences.en: And I felt like my learning started to plateau.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我的学习开始进入瓶颈期。

sentences.en: And it had always been in the back of my mind that I would apply for clinical psychology training.
sentences.zh: 我脑海里一直有个念头，那就是申请临床心理学培训。

sentences.en: So, I think once I realised I was going to live here forever, and my learning started to plateau in these other jobs, that's when I sort of turned my sights
sentences.zh: 所以我想，一旦我意识到我要永远住在这里，而且我在这些其他工作中的学习开始进入瓶颈，我便开始将目光

sentences.en: to training.
sentences.zh: 转向了培训。

sentences.en: And I completed a master's here, which I did alongside a full-time job, and then applied for my first AP job.
sentences.zh: 我在这里完成了一个硕士学位，是一边做着全职工作一边读的，然后申请了我的第一份助理心理学家工作。

sentences.en: And that was in a neurodevelopmental assessment service for children.
sentences.zh: 那是在一个针对儿童的神经发育评估服务机构。

sentences.en: And then I had a child, and I got on to training.
sentences.zh: 然后我生了个孩子，接着就进入了培训。

sentences.en: So, it was sort of perhaps quite a different journey to other people.
sentences.zh: 所以这或许是一段与其他人相当不同的经历。

sentences.en: I was never in a rush.
sentences.zh: 我从来不急。

sentences.en: It was, for me, I think, I felt like I'd always end up as a clinical psychologiSt. But I just found myself in jobs that I just really enjoyed,
sentences.zh: 对我而言，我想，我总觉得我最终会成为一名临床心理学家。但我只是发现自己做的工作都是我真的很喜欢的，

sentences.en: and I was very passionate about, I was learning a lot.
sentences.zh: 而且我充满热情，学到了很多东西。

sentences.en: And that's why I sort of meandered my way here, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是我为什么会兜兜转转来到这里吧。

sentences.en: Well done to you.
sentences.zh: 真了不起。

sentences.en: I was speaking to someone earlier that was saying, you know, I can't believe I get paid to do this, because I would actually do it for free.
sentences.zh: 我刚才跟某个人聊天时还在说，你知道的，“我简直不敢相信做这个还能拿薪水，因为我其实是愿意免费干的。”

sentences.en: And that's when you know that this is a career that is just a bit of you, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这就是当你意识到这不仅是一份职业，而且非常适合你的时候，对吧？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Although the pay helps.
sentences.zh: 不过有薪水确实很有帮助。

sentences.en: Oh, the pay most definitely helps.
sentences.zh: 哦，有薪水绝对太有帮助了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I get very challenging otherwise.
sentences.zh: 不然日子会变得非常具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Just before we start thinking about children, I know that I have got people that do listen to podcasts in Australia.
sentences.zh: 就在我们开始考虑孩子之前，我知道有些听众是在澳大利亚听播客的。

sentences.en: And I know that a question I will be asked if I don't ask you, is how it worked, you know, moving from Australia to the UK, and whether you were then eligible to
sentences.zh: 我也知道如果我不问你，别人一定会问我的一个问题是，从澳大利亚搬到英国是怎么做到的，以及你当时是否符合

sentences.en: apply for the funded places.
sentences.zh: 申请带资培训名额的资格。

sentences.en: Just that sort of question, if you're comfortable answering it.
sentences.zh: 如果你不介意的话，就是关于这类问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, certainly.
sentences.zh: 好的，当然。

sentences.en: First of all, you need to be aware of whether your degree would be accredited here.
sentences.zh: 首先，你需要了解你的学位在这里是否会被认可。

sentences.en: So I think both countries are a little bit like our degrees are better than the other persons.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为两个国家都有点像觉得“我们的学位比别人的更好”。

sentences.en: So it is something you need to look into, you need to make sure you have the full four-year degree in Australia to be able to convert it here by the BPS.
sentences.zh: 所以这是你需要调查清楚的事情，你需要确保在澳大利亚拥有完整的四年制学位，才能通过英国心理学会（BPS）在这里进行换算。

sentences.en: For me, I have British heritage,
sentences.zh: 对我而言，我有英国血统，

sentences.en: British heritage.
sentences.zh: 英国血统。

sentences.en: So I already had a UK passport, even before I decided to move here.
sentences.zh: 所以我甚至在决定搬到这里之前就已经有一本英国护照了。

sentences.en: So it made moving to the country quite simple.
sentences.zh: 所以搬到这个国家对我和很简单。

sentences.en: But you do need to have lived here for, I think it's three years to get the residency.
sentences.zh: 但你确实需要在这里住过，我想是三年，才能获得居留权。

sentences.en: And that's a continuous three years.
sentences.zh: 而且那是连续的三年。

sentences.en: So you can't have like sort of been out of the country for too long during that period.
sentences.zh: 所以在此期间你不能离开这个国家太久。

sentences.en: They're in sort of set timeframes.
sentences.zh: 它们是在特定时间范围内的。

sentences.en: I think it's three years, you need to double check that.
sentences.zh: 我想是三年，你需要仔细核实这一点。

sentences.en: And once you're considered a resident of this country, you can apply.
sentences.zh: 一旦你被视为这个国家的居民，你就可以申请了。

sentences.en: I think courses will look out though, for, you know, they want people who are going to stay here.
sentences.zh: 不过我想课程主办方会注意，你知道的，他们想要那些会留在这里的人。

sentences.en: So they will, I think, probably look out for that a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以我想他们可能会在这方面多留意一下。

sentences.en: A commitment to staying and working in the NHS.
sentences.zh: 对留在英国和在NHS工作的承诺。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Lovely.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for a slight deviation.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你做了一点小小的偏离。

sentences.en: But I know that that will be a question that I am asked.
sentences.zh: 但我知道一定会有人问我这个问题。

sentences.en: Because it's important, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 因为这很重要，不是吗？

sentences.en: Especially the variability and diversity in our workforce.
sentences.zh: 特别是我们劳动力队伍的可变性和多样性。

sentences.en: And that, you know, I do believe, and I've said before, that I've got the best job in the world.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我确实相信，而且我以前也说过，我拥有世界上最棒的工作。

sentences.en: Why wouldn't someone in a different country know that and think, I'd love to do that?
sentences.zh: 为什么在另一个国家的人就不会知道这一点，然后心想：我也好想做那个？

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全如此。

sentences.en: Yeah, I can relate to that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我对此深有同感。

sentences.en: So, well, before we started recording, we were speaking a little bit about your experience of applying to the doctorate.
sentences.zh: 那么，在我们开始录音之前，我们稍微聊了一下你申请博士项目的经历。

sentences.en: Would you be okay telling us a little bit about what that was like, and where baby fell in that, if that's okay?
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，你能跟我们讲讲那是什么样的体验，以及孩子是在什么时候出生的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 好的，当然。

sentences.en: So I think, I mean, one of the reasons why, I guess I'm here, and I guess quite passionate about this is because I agonized over the decision to have a baby.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，我的意思是，为什么，我想我来到这里，并且对这个话题充满热情的原因之一，是因为我在要不要生孩子这个决定上纠结了很久。

sentences.en: And I can't underscore that enough.
sentences.zh: 怎么强调这一点都不为过。

sentences.en: Like, it really was agony.
sentences.zh: 真的，那简直是一种煎熬。

sentences.en: Because there are these really dominant narratives, I think, that you can't get onto training.
sentences.zh: 因为存在着这些非常强势的论调，我认为，即你根本无法通过培训入选。

sentences.en: It's incredibly hard.
sentences.zh: 这难得难以置信。

sentences.en: And that having any sort of difference
sentences.zh: 而且拥有任何形式的差异

sentences.en: just makes it harder, I think.
sentences.zh: 只会让事情变得更艰难，我是这么觉得的。

sentences.en: And having a child would mean, I guess, that you might be discriminated against by courses, but also that you can't get the adequate experience that you need to get onto training.
sentences.zh: 并且生孩子意味着，我猜，你可能会在申请课程时受到歧视，同时你也无法获得进入培训所需的充分经验。

sentences.en: And then even if you happen to get on, that you can't complete training with children because it is just so incredibly challenging.
sentences.zh: 然后，即使你碰巧考上了，你也无法带着孩子完成培训，因为这实在是太不可思议地具有挑战性了。

sentences.en: And I sort of, I heard that very strongly in the complete absence, actually, of having any narratives or stories of people who had completed training with children.
sentences.zh: 而且我有一种感觉，实际上，在完全没有任何人带着孩子完成培训的经历或故事的情况下，这种感觉非常强烈。

sentences.en: I don't know, I really felt that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，我真的深有同感。

sentences.en: And yeah, I was really in a place where it's like, what if, you know, what ifs?
sentences.zh: 而且是的，我当时真的处于一种状态，就好像是，如果……你知道的，如果发生这种情况会怎样？

sentences.en: They're never good, are they?
sentences.zh: 这些假设从来都不是什么好事，对吧？

sentences.en: But what if I dedicate myself to training and I finish and I am unable to have children?
sentences.zh: 但如果我全身心投入培训，最后完成了，却无法生育孩子怎么办？

sentences.en: Or what if I have a child and that means that I can never get onto training?
sentences.zh: 或者如果我生了孩子，这意味着我永远无法进入培训怎么办？

sentences.en: And I think because there's two very uncertain things, having a child, you have no idea what your life would look like with a child.
sentences.zh: 我想是因为存在两个非常不确定的因素：有了孩子，你根本不知道有了孩子之后你的生活会是什么样子。

sentences.en: And then,
sentences.zh: 然后，

sentences.en: so you can't sort of plan and think how I could make that work because you don't really know.
sentences.zh: 所以你无法进行规划去思考如何让它行得通，因为你真的不知道。

sentences.en: And then training, you just don't know that you're like, you don't know what the experience will be like, but also you don't know if you'll get on or when you'll get on.
sentences.zh: 接着是培训，你只是不知道——就像你不知道经历会是怎样，而且你也不知道自己是否能考上，或者什么时候能考上。

sentences.en: Will I get on when I'm 32 or
sentences.zh: 我会不会在32岁的时候考上，还是
35岁，或者38岁？

sentences.en: And what does that mean for my fertility?
sentences.zh: 这对我生育能力意味着什么？

sentences.en: So I really struggled with it.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的为此挣扎了很久。

sentences.en: And I guess I just started applying.
sentences.zh: 我想我只是开始申请了。

sentences.en: I applied after I had got my first AP job and I did have the baby.
sentences.zh: 我在得到第一份助理心理学家工作后申请了，我也确实把孩子生了下来。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 然后

sentences.en: I applied before I knew that I was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 我在知道自己怀孕之前就提交了申请。

sentences.en: So during my, when some of the interview season came up and I was offered three interviews.
sentences.zh: 所以在我的一些面试季到来时，我收到了三场面试邀请。

sentences.en: I was sort of eight months pregnant and my son was born prematurely.
sentences.zh: 我当时怀孕大约八个月，我的儿子早产了。

sentences.en: So that meant that actually the day, the day he was born, I think I had an interview or maybe it was the day after.
sentences.zh: 这意味着实际上就在他出生的那天，我想我正好有一场面试，或者也许是第二天。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, obviously couldn't attend.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉，显然我没能去参加。

sentences.en: And then I was quite poorly after he was born and I was in hospital for a week.
sentences.zh: 在他出生后我的身体状况很差，在医院住了一个星期。

sentences.en: And then I had an interview two days after I'd gotten out of hospital.
sentences.zh: 接着在我出院两天后我有一场面试。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 然后

sentences.en: and I attended that interview.
sentences.zh: 我参加了那场面试。

sentences.en: And I think on reflection, that seems actually ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 现在回想起来，这真的太荒谬了。

sentences.en: Like a really almost silly thing to do.
sentences.zh: 简直就像是一件愚蠢至极的事。

sentences.en: But I think again, there was this narrative that like, even if you get an interview this year, you might not get one next year.
sentences.zh: 但我想同样地，当时有一种说法：即使你今年获得了面试机会，明年也可能拿不到了。

sentences.en: So you have to apply.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须去申请。

sentences.en: Oh, so you have to go.
sentences.zh: 哦，所以你必须去。

sentences.en: I have to do it.
sentences.zh: 我必须这么做。

sentences.en: And I did do it, having not slept for 10 days.
sentences.zh: 我也确实去做了，当时我已经连续10天没睡觉了。

sentences.en: And it didn't go well.
sentences.zh: 结果并不顺利。

sentences.en: I mean, well, actually, do you know what, to be fair, the interview went well, but there was a written component that I just, my brain just wouldn't function for.
sentences.zh: 我是说——其实，你知道吗说实话，面试进行得挺顺利的，但其中有一个笔试部分，我的大脑当时根本无法正常运转。

sentences.en: And then I had an interview about a week after that, which I did attend.
sentences.zh: 然后大约一周后我又参加了一场面试。

sentences.en: And I, and I got on a reserve list for that one.
sentences.zh: 而且我，我那次进入了候补名单。

sentences.en: But I actually think another probably important part of that motivation to attend is also financially.
sentences.zh: 但我实际上认为，促使我去参加面试的另一个重要原因可能也是出于经济考虑。

sentences.en: So I think I, at that stage, my financial situation was such that I thought I might have to work in about six months anyway.
sentences.zh: 所以我想在那个阶段，我的财务状况让我觉得无论如何我可能在六个月左右就得开始工作了。

sentences.en: And part of my rationale was, well, I could work as an AP.
sentences.zh: 我的理由之一是，好吧，我可以去当助理心理学家。

sentences.en: And after I paid for my childcare and my travel, I'll bring home about $50, so 50 pounds a week.
sentences.zh: 扣除托儿费和交通费后，我每周大概能带回家50美元，也就是50英镑。

sentences.en: Or I could go back to a more demanding job, which would be training, but at least I'd have enough money to sort of survive on.
sentences.zh: 或者我可以回到一份要求更高、也就是培训的工作中去，但至少我会有足够的钱勉强维持生存。

sentences.en: And I think
sentences.zh: 我想

sentences.en: that is probably, I think, one of the big barriers, I think, to having trained, to having children when
sentences.zh: 这可能是，我认为，在尝试进入临床心理学博士培训（D-Clin）时生孩子的一大障碍，托儿费用实在是

sentences.en: you're trying to get onto the D-Clin is the cost of childcare is, it's just eye-wateringly high.
sentences.zh: 高得令人瞠目结舌。

sentences.en: It will be almost your entire income as a bandfall AP.
sentences.zh: 它几乎会花光你作为初级助理心理学家的全部收入。

sentences.en: So I guess that was the process.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这就是整个过程。

sentences.en: And then, so I didn't get on that year.
sentences.zh: 然后，我那一年没有考上。

sentences.en: And then I applied again the following year, and I got two interviews and, and two offers.
sentences.zh: 接着我在第二年再次申请，获得了两次面试机会，并拿到了两份录取通知。

sentences.en: And at that stage, my son was a year old.
sentences.zh: 当时，我的儿子已经一岁了。

sentences.en: Oh, well, well done to you.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇，真为你高兴。

sentences.en: And honestly, you're my hero attending interviews for doctorate training, whilst in the fog of being a very new mother.
sentences.zh: 老实说，在作为一个新手母亲的迷茫状态下，一边去参加博士培训面试，你简直是我的英雄。

sentences.en: Kudos to you and also getting a reserve list place that year.
sentences.zh: 向你致敬，而且那一年还进了候补名单。

sentences.en: Like you are my hero.
sentences.zh: 就像你真的是我的偶像。

sentences.en: So well done to you on that.
sentences.zh: 所以在这方面真的为你感到骄傲。

sentences.en: Can I ask, when you were applying the next year, whether you, you know, whether you considered more family friendly courses or whether
sentences.zh: 我可以问一下，第二年申请的时候，你有没有，你知道的，有没有考虑过那些对家庭更友好的课程，或者说

sentences.en: you considered any factors around, you know, having your son or was it purely the traditional, I like the sound of that course.
sentences.zh: 你有没有考虑过关于抚养儿子的各种因素，还是说完全是传统的“我觉得那个课程听起来不错”？

sentences.en: And you know, I've met other trainees, etc.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，我遇到过其他学员等等。

sentences.en: Um, I didn't change.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我没有改变。

sentences.en: Well, it's really hard to get any sort of sense of who is family friendly from the information on the clearinghouse.
sentences.zh: 好吧，从招考中心（Clearinghouse）的信息里，真的很难搞清楚到底哪个课程对家庭友好。

sentences.en: And in fact, I don't think any of the courses appear family friendly.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我觉得没有任何一个课程看起来对家庭友好。

sentences.en: I don't think it's mentioned anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我觉得任何地方都没提到过这一点。

sentences.en: I've certainly never heard of courses that like invite parents to attend or speak to it in the information that they put out.
sentences.zh: 我当然从未听说过有哪个课程在他们发布的信息中会邀请父母参加或专门谈及此事。

sentences.en: Before you apply.
sentences.zh: 在你申请之前。

sentences.en: So I was sort of, it was a little bit blind, actually.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时基本上有点像是在盲选。

sentences.en: It was more about what I thought the ethos would be.
sentences.zh: 这更多是基于我认为它们的精神风貌会是怎样的。

sentences.en: But actually, having said that, I then actually attended to the two interviews that I attended that year.
sentences.zh: 但话虽如此，我后来确实参加了那一年我收到的两次面试。

sentences.en: I actually attended one where I think they made it very clear, actually, it wasn't even covert, they made it very clear, I think that they would

sentences.zh: 不会支持父母或照顾者完成培训，面试一开始就有

sentences.en: And my heart, it was so devastating.
sentences.zh: 我的心碎极了，太令人崩溃了。

sentences.en: I remember I finished that interview, and I walked out the door, and my first thought was, I did really well today, I think I'm going to get an offer.
sentences.zh: 我记得我结束那场面试走出门时，我的第一个想法是：我今天表现得真好，我想我能拿到录取通知。

sentences.en: And my second thought, which I followed about two seconds later was, and I cannot accept it.
sentences.zh: 而我的第二个想法，在大约两秒钟后紧随而至：但我根本无法接受它。

sentences.en: Um, I just, I knew that I would have a miserable time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我只是——我知道如果去了我会过得很痛苦。

sentences.en: I knew that I probably wouldn't even get through it.
sentences.zh: 我知道我甚至可能无法撑过去。

sentences.en: Um, and then the following week, I did this other interview, my training course that I'm on, and it couldn't have been a more different experience.
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后接下来的星期我参加了另一场面试，也就是我现在正在上的这个培训课程，经历简直可以说是天壤之别。

sentences.en: Um, in my interview, they asked me, uh, how are you going to, like, what are your thoughts, and how you might manage, um, being a
sentences.zh: 嗯，在面试中他们问我，呃，你打算怎么做——比如，你有什么想法，你将如何应对

sentences.zh: 作为父母并同时完成这个课程，我能够谈论这些。

sentences.en: And that was fine.
sentences.zh: 这很好。

sentences.en: They seemed quite warm, and they sort of said that they do try to take that into account, and there are some adjustments that they can made, and they explained what they were.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来非常热情，并且表示他们确实会尽量把这考虑在内，他们可以做出一些调整，还解释了具体是哪些调整。

sentences.en: And, um, yeah, it was, it was such a relief.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，真的是，太让人松了一口气了。

sentences.en: Um, and that, of course, I got the two offers, and I knew exactly where I needed to be.
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后那个课程我拿到了两份录取通知，我知道自己该去哪里了。

sentences.en: Um, so it was actually very helpful, really, in the end, but it was also, you know, quite heartbreaking as well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以到头来其实真的很有帮助，但与此同时，你知道的，也挺让人心碎的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.zh: 是的，在这个过程中被当成一个人、一个重要的人来对待是多么重要，而不是仅仅被当成一个可以轻易被取代的数字，因为你是一个人，

sentences.zh: 自己不仅仅是精疲力竭，然后还能作为一个父母去陪伴孩子。

sentences.zh: 嗯，她甚至成了我们这个小组的“妈妈”，你知道的，她是我听过的第一个在谈到抚养孩子时
